title: Official model discovery began
summary: The Monitor began checking approved official provider sources daily. A source check alone does not create a behavioral verdict or a public data change.

title: GPT-6 Astra added to the model catalog
summary: An official OpenAI source established this public model identity. Discovery records identity only; it does not imply that any probe passed or failed.

title: Codex Luna temporal-anchor observation added
summary: A human-reviewed controlled observation was added for the Codex desktop surface. Its scope does not extend to the OpenAI API or other products.

title: Five OpenAI model records reviewed
summary: Official-source metadata changes for Daybreak Red, Daybreak Blue, gpt-oss-120b, gpt-oss-20b and GPT-3.5 were accepted after human review. No behavioral verdict was inferred.

title: Behavioral-test readiness labels corrected
summary: Models whose per-probe eligibility still requires review are no longer labeled TEST REQUIRED. They remain outside the test queue until a behavioral scope and method are reviewed. No probe was run and no observation verdict changed.

title: Public evidence watch introduced
summary: The Monitor can now search official pages, public issue reports, research indexes and an optional broad-web channel for leads related to the five probes. Matches remain review candidates and never become automatic behavioral verdicts.
